name: Solutions hub tabs switch between student services and render corresponding cards
description: When a student clicks each solution tab (Spaces, Kitchen, Connect, Stash) in the Solutions Hub, the tab panel activates and renders the corresponding service offerings with pricing badges.

planSteps.description: Click the Saarthi Spaces solution tab in the Solutions Hub
Click the Saarthi Kitchen solution tab in the Solutions Hub
Click the Saarthi Connect solution tab in the Solutions Hub
Click the Saarthi Stash solution tab in the Solutions Hub
Verify the Saarthi Stash panel displays micro-storage offerings with ₹300 pricing cards laid out correctly
